articles.summary: Stem cell research is transitioning from theory to clinical reality, with over 750 recent trials targeting conditions like osteoarthritis and heart disease. Compared to surgery, these treatments are minimally invasive with faster recovery times. Companies like Forever Labs now offer biobanking, allowing individuals to preserve their young cells for future longevity treatments.
